annotations.title: Expansion brief for a target region (Legend tier)

description: The one-call brief a services practice reads before opening a subsidiary in another region: providers already there (by kind and by country, and how many are LOCAL entities versus members of multi-region groups), SAP end-customers there (by country and by industry — counts from the Legend corpus, never rows), live opportunities by country, and the BRIDGE GROUPS — brand families that hold entities both in the target region and in your home region (or anywhere else when `home_region` is omitted). Regions are the platform's six-value geography: EMEA holds Europe AND the Middle East, AFRICA is its own region, AMER is North America, LATAM and APAC are what they say, GLOBAL is the country-unknown bucket and is refused as a target. Day rates are NOT in this brief: call get_day_rate_benchmark per country; it answers only for the countries listed in its `available_countries` (Europe, the Middle East, North America and a few APAC countries at low/medium confidence) and refuses the rest rather than transpose a European band. Every count is read at query time from the SSOT. Requires a subscriber API key, Legend tier or above.

home_region.description: Optional. The region you operate from today. When set, bridge groups are the families present in BOTH regions; when omitted, in the target region and any other.

target_region.description: The region you want to enter. One of EMEA, AMER, LATAM, APAC, AFRICA (GLOBAL is refused: it is not a market).
